Subject: Activating new supplier: PO enrollment & invoice payload expectations

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call earlier. We want to move Helios through our supplier activation checklist this week and I had a couple of concrete asks so Finance Ops can finish the PO enrollment. Please see below: 

1) PO enrollment: can you confirm whether Helios will accept POs issued to a single legal entity (Helios Systems, EIN xxx-xx-xxxx) or if you require POs per operating subsidiary? If multiple legal entities are required we need legal name + remit address per entity so we can map POs correctly.

2) Invoice submission: our default is a vendor portal (preferred) with email as the fallback. If you prefer email-only for the first 90 days, upload a sample invoice (CSV or PDF) that represents your typical line items. Can you also confirm whether you include multiple PO numbers on a single invoice or send one invoice per PO?

3) Payload schema: attached is our updated vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_form_v2.pdf). If you could send one sample invoice file (CSV) using your system export, that will help our AP mapping team. Short example of fields we need: invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO), total_amount, tax_amount, currency, line_items (description/qty/unit_price), po_number, remit_address, payment_terms.

4) Timing: target to have the first PO issued by Thursday, 13 Jun. Is that feasible on your side?

If it helps, Laura from Finance Ops (cc'd) can pick a 20-minute slot to walk through the portal screens during onboarding.

Best,
Karthik

--

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and attaching a sample export.

1) Legal entities: Helios can accept a single PO to the holding company (Helios Systems, LLC). We do have registered subsidiaries but for Redwood we recommend using the holding company name to keep remittance simple.

2) Invoice submission: we strongly prefer uploading invoices to our vendor portal (portal.helios-sys.com). For the activation we can accept emailed invoices to procurement@helios-sys.com for up to 60 days, after which portal submissions will be required. We usually send one invoice per PO.

3) Sample invoice: attached is helios_sample_invoice.csv (first 3 lines) and our W-9 (helios_w9.pdf). CSV includes columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, total_amount, currency, remit_address.

4) Timing: issuing a PO by Thu 13 Jun is fine on our side — we can complete portal enrollment today if you send the vendor form back.

See attached and let me know if you want a quick portal walk-through tomorrow morning.

Best,
Samantha

Samantha —

Quick follow-up from Finance Ops: a couple of clarifications so our AP mapping matches your output cleanly.

• Remit address: Please confirm the remit address to appear on the CSV (single field preferred). If your system exports separate address columns, we can concatenate, but a single remit_address field reduces mapping errors.

• Multiple PO numbers: you mentioned one invoice per PO — good. If there is ever a case where a vendor must include multiple POs on a single invoice, we prefer PO numbers pipe-delimited in the po_number field (e.g., PO123|PO124).

• Currency & Taxes: please ensure currency uses ISO code (USD) and tax_amount is per-line where applicable.

• PDF attachments: if your invoice is a PDF attachment in email fallback, include the invoice_number in the email subject line to enable automated file matching (e.g., Invoice INV-2029-001 for PO PO-98765).

If you'd like, Marissa in onboarding can accept the vendor form and start the DocuSign flow.

Thanks —
Laura
